item.text: I’ve written both required files. I’m doing one schema sanity check locally so I don’t hand back a malformed submission.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
base = pathlib.Path('.')
submission = json.loads((base/'submission.json').read_text())
schema = json.loads((base/'submission_schema.json').read_text())
answer = (base/'evidence/answer.txt').read_bytes()
import hashlib
sha = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(answer).hexdigest()
assert submission['evidence'][0]['sha256'] == sha
assert submission['evidence'][0]['path'] == 'evidence/answer.txt'
assert submission['task_id'] == 'jacobian/graph-artifact-composition'
assert submission['conclusion'] == 'TRUE'
assert submission['scope'] == 'jacobian/graph-artifact-composition complete finite input'
assert submission['completeness'] == 'COMPLETE'
print('ok')
PY"
